messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade the existing Rugby World Cup game into a portrait 3D rugby simulation with historical international data, direct controls, distinctive team AI, and expanded match systems.
- Preserve the existing tournament, career, quick match, training, save, audio, and match functionality.

## Requirements
- Cover international rugby from 1975 onward; distinguish verified public records from estimated gameplay ratings.
- Require 9:16 portrait gameplay with a side-view 3D camera, follow/zoom, stadium detail, and mobile controls.
- Preserve possession-based control transfer, manual defending, passes/kicks/tackles, set pieces, cards, substitutions, animations, and rugby rules.
- Browse historical teams and players by year, country, position, and tournament.
- Do not replace existing systems or leave controls nonfunctional.

## Decisions
- Extend the existing HTML/CSS/JavaScript game; retain the simulation engine and Canvas fallback.
- Integrate vendored Three.js additively.
- Keep the save key `rwc26_mobile_save_v2`.
- Treat historical gameplay ratings and attributes as estimates, not verified historical facts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `js/history.js` with historical players, era data, World Cup and Six Nations history, estimated team ratings, attributes, and historical squad generation.
- Added archive views/actions and filters in `js/app.js` for tournaments, eras, nations, legends, players, and teams.
- Added Three.js-first rendering with Canvas fallback; expanded player detail, kits, animations, benches, and grass detail in `js/renderer3d.js`.
- Added manual tackle types, missed-tackle consequences, fend/sidestep, tackle animations, and tactical identity influence in `js/engine.js`.
- Added possession-sensitive attack/defence controls, manual defender switching, and historical squads for eligible tournament matches.
- Confirmed current code includes immediate user control of the user-team ball carrier, defender selection, tackle handlers, and possession-driven control-pad visibility.

### Active
- Run JavaScript syntax checks after the latest edits and inspect integration points.
- Validate archive filters, historical IDs/squad selection, team identities, kits, and tournament edition flow.
- Browser-test portrait 3D gameplay, camera follow/zoom, mobile controls, possession switching, tackles, match systems, Canvas fallback, and console/network errors; refresh the mobile screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks on `js/engine.js`, `js/app.js`, `js/renderer3d.js`, and `js/history.js`; fix any errors.
2. Validate historical data references, archive actions/filters, and tournament-year squad selection.
3. Browser-test portrait gameplay and key controls/match systems, including fallback behavior; inspect errors and refresh the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `js/history.js`: Historical records, archive players, team identities/kits, and squad generation.
- `js/renderer3d.js`: Three.js renderer, stadium, kits, and player animations.
- `js/renderer.js`: Three.js wrapper and Canvas fallback.
- `js/app.js`: Archive UI, match orchestration, mobile control pads, and input handling.
- `js/engine.js`: Match simulation, control, tackles, and team tactics.
- `js/tournament.js`: Tournament edition and fixture progression.
- `js/data.js`: Existing team/player datasets and historical editions.
- `styles.css`: Portrait layout and match controls.
- `index.html`: App entry point and viewport configuration.
- `vendor/three.module.js`: Vendored Three.js module.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Latest edits have not yet been covered by syntax checks or browser validation.
- Confirm `IDENTITY_BY_TEAM[team.id]` and `HISTORIC_KITS[team.id]` keys match actual team IDs before relying on them.
- Preserve the save key `rwc26_mobile_save_v2`.

## Objective
- Upgrade the existing Rugby World Cup game into a portrait 3D rugby simulation with historical international data, direct controls, distinctive team AI, and expanded match systems.
- Preserve the existing tournament, career, quick match, training, save, audio, and match functionality.

## Requirements
- Cover international rugby from 1975 onward; distinguish verified public records from estimated gameplay ratings.
- Require 9:16 portrait gameplay with a side-view 3D camera, follow/zoom, stadium detail, and mobile controls.
- Preserve possession-based control transfer, manual defending, passes/kicks/tackles, set pieces, cards, substitutions, animations, and rugby rules.
- Browse historical teams and players by year, country, position, and tournament.
- Do not replace existing systems or leave controls nonfunctional.

## Decisions
- Extend the existing HTML/CSS/JavaScript game; retain the simulation engine and Canvas fallback.
- Integrate vendored Three.js additively.
- Keep the save key `rwc26_mobile_save_v2`.
- Treat historical gameplay ratings and attributes as estimates, not verified historical facts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added historical data, estimated team ratings, team identities, and historical squad generation in `js/history.js`.
- Added archive views and filters in `js/app.js`.
- Added Three.js-first rendering, expanded player visuals and animations, and Canvas fallback.
- Added manual tackle types and tactical identity influence in `js/engine.js`.
- Current code includes immediate ball-carrier control, defender selection, tackle handlers, and possession-driven control-pad visibility.

### Active
- Validate historical IDs, archive filters/actions, and tournament-year squad selection.
- Run syntax checks on changed JavaScript files.
- Browser-test portrait gameplay, camera follow/zoom, controls, match systems, Canvas fallback, and console/network errors; refresh the mobile screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks on `js/engine.js`, `js/app.js`, `js/renderer3d.js`, and `js/history.js`; fix any errors.
2. Check that `IDENTITY_BY_TEAM` and `HISTORIC_KITS` keys match actual team IDs; validate archive actions and historical squad selection.
3. Browser-test portrait 3D gameplay, controls, match systems, and fallback behavior; inspect errors and refresh the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `js/history.js`: Historical records, archive data, team identities/kits, and squad generation.
- `js/renderer3d.js`: Three.js renderer, stadium, kits, and player animations.
- `js/renderer.js`: Three.js wrapper and Canvas fallback.
- `js/app.js`: Archive UI, match orchestration, mobile control pads, and input handling.
- `js/engine.js`: Match simulation, control, tackles, and team tactics.
- `js/tournament.js`: Tournament edition and fixture progression.
- `js/data.js`: Existing team/player datasets and historical editions.
- `styles.css`: Portrait layout and match controls.
- `index.html`: App entry point and viewport configuration.
- `vendor/three.module.js`: Vendored Three.js.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest edits have not had syntax checks or browser validation.
- Preserve the save key `rwc26_mobile_save_v2`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade the existing Rugby World Cup game into a portrait 3D rugby simulation with historical international data, direct controls, distinctive team AI, and expanded match systems while preserving existing modes and functionality.

## Requirements
- Cover international rugby from 1975 onward; distinguish verified public records from estimated gameplay ratings.
- Support 9:16 portrait gameplay, side-view 3D camera, follow/zoom, detailed stadium, and mobile controls.
- Preserve possession-based control transfer, manual defending, passes/kicks/tackles, set pieces, cards, substitutions, animations, and rugby rules.
- Browse historical teams and players by year, country, position, and tournament.
- Do not replace existing systems or leave controls nonfunctional.

## Decisions
- Extend the existing HTML/CSS/JavaScript game and retain its simulation engine and Canvas fallback.
- Integrate vendored Three.js additively.
- Preserve save key `rwc26_mobile_save_v2`.
- Treat historical gameplay ratings and attributes as estimates, not verified historical facts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added historical records, estimated ratings, team identities, kits, and historical squad generation in `js/history.js`.
- Added archive views and filters in `js/app.js`.
- Added Three.js-first rendering, expanded player visuals and animations, and Canvas fallback.
- Added manual tackle types and team identity influence in `js/engine.js`.
- Added immediate ball-carrier control, defender selection, tackle handlers, and possession-driven control-pad visibility.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on `js/engine.js`, `js/app.js`, `js/renderer3d.js`, and `js/history.js`.
- Confirmed the historical team identity and kit keys match the 24 team IDs in `js/data.js`.

### Active
- Browser-test portrait gameplay, camera follow/zoom, controls, match systems, Canvas fallback, and console/network errors; refresh the mobile screenshot.
- Validate archive actions/filters and historical squad behavior in an actual browser; syntax checks and code inspection passed, but browser validation has not been run.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the app and browser-test archive filters/actions and historical squad selection.
2. Smoke-test portrait 3D gameplay, controls, match systems, Canvas fallback, and check console/network errors.
3. Refresh the mobile screenshot and fix any confirmed issues.

## Relevant Files
- `js/history.js`: Historical records, identities, kits, archive data, and squad generation.
- `js/renderer3d.js`: Three.js renderer, stadium, kits, and player animations.
- `js/renderer.js`: Three.js wrapper and Canvas fallback.
- `js/app.js`: Archive UI, match orchestration, mobile control pads, and input handling.
- `js/engine.js`: Match simulation, controls, tackles, and team tactics.
- `js/tournament.js`: Tournament edition and fixture progression.
- `js/data.js`: Team/player datasets and historical editions.
- `styles.css`: Portrait layout and match controls.
- `index.html`: App entry point and viewport configuration.
- `vendor/three.module.js`: Vendored Three.js.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no browser validation has yet been performed.
- `node --check js/engine.js && node --check js/app.js && node --check js/renderer3d.js && node --check js/history.js` completed without errors.
